related.title: Bloom filter：誤判率與不准假陰性
related.titleEn: Bloom filters: false positives without false negatives
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：追蹤同一 key 跨 SSTable 的版本，合併時只保留符合快照政策的最新值。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Trace key versions across SSTables and merge according to snapshot retention policy. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 建立 bit array 與固定雜湊位置，測試不存在 key 的誤判及已插入 key 的保證。
related.differenceEn: Build a bit array with fixed hash positions and test false positives while retaining inserted-key membership.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: LSM 以批次有序檔降低隨機寫入，後續 compaction 會重寫資料；tombstone 刪除也有保存條件。 教學基準：100*3+200+300 = 800 physical MiB written；第二檢核：800/300 = 2.666666667 write amplification。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。

標準只增不刪 Bloom filter 可有假陽性，不能有假陰性；誤判公式假設近似獨立均勻雜湊。 教學基準：(1-exp(-7*100/1000))**7 = 0.008193722066 approximate false-positive probability；第二檢核：1000/8 = 125 bit-array bytes。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: LSM trees batch sorted writes but compaction rewrites data; tombstone removal also requires retention conditions. Teaching baseline: 100*3+200+300 = 800 physical MiB written; second check: 800/300 = 2.666666667 write amplification. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

A standard insert-only Bloom filter allows false positives but no false negatives; rate formulas assume approximately uniform independent hashes. Teaching baseline: (1-exp(-7*100/1000))**7 = 0.008193722066 approximate false-positive probability; second check: 1000/8 = 125 bit-array bytes. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 一致性雜湊：ring、虛擬節點與搬移集合
related.titleEn: Consistent hashing: rings,virtual nodes and moved keys
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：追蹤同一 key 跨 SSTable 的版本，合併時只保留符合快照政策的最新值。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Trace key versions across SSTables and merge according to snapshot retention policy. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 把鍵映到 token ring，新增節點後列出真正改變 owner 的鍵。
related.differenceEn: Map keys onto a token ring and enumerate ownership changes after adding a node.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: LSM 以批次有序檔降低隨機寫入，後續 compaction 會重寫資料；tombstone 刪除也有保存條件。 教學基準：100*3+200+300 = 800 physical MiB written；第二檢核：800/300 = 2.666666667 write amplification。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
一致性雜湊減少重分配範圍但不保證均衡；虛擬節點增加取樣機會，仍需量測偏斜。 教學基準：1/5*100 = 20 keys remapped percent；第二檢核：35-20 = 15 new token interval length。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: LSM trees batch sorted writes but compaction rewrites data; tombstone removal also requires retention conditions. Teaching baseline: 100*3+200+300 = 800 physical MiB written; second check: 800/300 = 2.666666667 write amplification. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Consistent hashing limits remapping but does not guarantee balance; virtual nodes improve sampling while skew still needs measurement. Teaching baseline: 1/5*100 = 20 keys remapped percent; second check: 35-20 = 15 new token interval length. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
